definitions.gloss: mail order; online shopping; distance selling
definitions.explanation: Abbreviated form of {通信販売|つうしんはんばい} (distance selling). Originally referred to catalog-based mail order, but now primarily refers to online shopping through websites and apps.

examples.japanese: {通販|つうはん}で{靴|くつ}を{買|か}った。
この{商品|しょうひん}は{通販|つうはん}でしか{買|か}えない。
examples.english: This product can only be purchased through online shopping.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{通販|つうはん}で{食料品|しょくりょうひん}まで{届|とど}けてもらえるので、{買|か}い{物|もの}に{出|で}かける{回数|かいすう}が{減|へ}った。
examples.english: Lately, you can even get groceries delivered through online shopping, so I go out to shop less often.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}. In modern Japanese, {通販|つうはん} almost always refers to online shopping through websites like Amazon or Rakuten. The full form {通信販売|つうしんはんばい} sounds more formal and is used in legal or business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通販|つうはん}サイト (online shopping site)
- {通販|つうはん}で{買|か}う (to buy online)
- {通販|つうはん}で{届|とど}く (to arrive via online order)
- テレビ{通販|つうはん} (TV shopping)
- ネット{通販|つうはん} (internet shopping)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ネットショッピング: online shopping — borrowed English term, same meaning
- {通信販売|つうしんはんばい}: distance selling — the unabbreviated, more formal form
